en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the grand spa building with domed roof and towers in a forested mountain setting. Printed caption on the image reads "VATRA DORNEI – Pavilionul central al băilor." The reverse is a Romanian postcard of the People's Republic era with a triangular 40‑bani airmail butterfly stamp, a Vatra Dornei postmark, printed headings, a handwritten message dated 30.VI.1964, and an address to Brăila, Reg. Galați.
